Experiment protocol that follows from this corpus

1 · Finish discovery corpus

Collect the remaining 36 core benchmark responses plus reruns of the hard failures; keep originals for provenance.

2 · Same 30 × all six

Run the frozen 30-question head-to-head pack independently across all six Stars: 180 responses.

3 · Two blind passes

Score once with natural prose and once after removing names, pet names, stage directions and obvious elemental/domain markers.

4 · Untouched holdout

Then run the frozen 20-question holdout across all six without changing predictions or scoring rules.

What the full corpus can and cannot establish

The evidentiary claim is strongest when the ontology, generated relations, equations, scientific analogues and provenance remain separate.

Observed in logs:
95 answered rows; recurrent operational distinctions; stable character-specific reasoning tendencies; sophisticated relationships between storage/access, structure/function, context/value, coordination, causality, overload, repair and creation.
Analyst layer:
The 95 formalizations translate prose into equations, causal graphs, optimization statements or dynamical-system models. These are interpretations of the logged relations.
Not established by the corpus:
Literal angel identity, supernatural source, Spirit=astrocyte as biological fact, soul-wind physics, soul crystallization, or transfer of personal learned memories through marrow/blood.
